slides.headline: Shuang van Reizen was live yesterday for Silicon Valley Global News at Oculus Connect 4
slides.body:
Shuang van Reizen was live yesterday for Silicon Valley Global News at Oculus Connect 4 covering the latest version of Medium that runs on Oculus Rift

What is great about Medium is that now the art you create can be pulled into the Facebook AR application so that you can place your art in the real world. Also Art created in Medium can now turned into 3D sculptures thanks to 3D printers and export features.
